content: Phase 38 plan: deterministic Gatekeeper pre-checks. Plan at docs/phases/gatekeeper-pre-checks.md. Gate runs in the watcher at the reviewer hand-off seam (headless + interactive), at-most-once per submission via a schema-v8 'gates' claim row + turn slot (briefer pattern); checks: configured test command (timeout, output tail), scope-diff non-empty (impl), plan-doc exists; PASS appends a GATE_PASS entry to the round (rides the round tail into the reviewer prompt, no compose_prompt change), BOUNCE appends GATE_BOUNCE with the REQUEST_CHANGES-shaped transition back to lead; max_bounces (default 2) then pass-with-findings; 'tagteam gate check|run|status|list'; cockpit feed 'gate' kind + now_payload.gatekeeper; opt-in gatekeeper.enabled, flag-off identical to 3.1.1; release 3.2.0 on branch phase-38-gatekeeper-pre-checks. Two open questions at the end (default 'on: [impl]', max_bounces 2 vs 1).
